0022600134.text: The Charlotte Hornets (3-1, first in the Southeast and third in the East, winners of their last two) visit the Detroit Pistons (3-1, first in the Central and first in the East, coming off a loss) in the Hornets' fifth game of the season. Charlotte is without Coby White, Grant Williams, Kon Knueppel, and Kylan Boswell, while Detroit is missing Jalen Duren and Isaiah Joe is day-to-day with a hip bruise and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and last season the Hornets lost all three meetings, most recently 118-100 in Charlotte on April 10, 2026.
